messages.subject: Modularity test for linear leg meansurements - Stuck with n x variables matrix and partitioning
parts:
Hi All,

I would like to run a modularity.test on insect legs. I measured the length of each leg segment (5 segments in total) across 10 species - my data is linear and not shape/landmark data.

My data frame is individuals (rows) by leg segment (columns) (see attached data).

The first problem is I don't know how to get my data into the correct format for Argument A? How do I coerce it into an n x variables matrix for the test?

Secondly, I am stuck with how to partition the data according to my hypotheses (which I give below) for partition.gp.

Hypos    Seg1    Seg2    Seg3    Seg4    Seg5
H1    2    1    1    1    1
H2    2    2    1    1    3
H3    1    1    2    3    3
H4    1    2    3    4    5


Sorry for the rookie questions - Any help would be appreciated.

Cheers
Jon

parts:
John,

 

A few things. First, please read the help files more carefully.  The function ‘modularity.test’ will allow either a 3D array or a matrix as data input.


Second, your design does not make sense. One cannot have a single variable as its own module, as there is no covariation within that module.


Dean
